verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents a code-first API with a full scene graph (meshes, lights, cameras, materials) plus mesh manipulation, typed for TypeScript, so an agent can create scenes and nodes and edit their properties in code. Nothing documents a scriptable interface for its editors (Inspector, Playground, Node Material Editor), and the probes found no OpenAPI spec and no official MCP server. Missing for 10: programmatic control of the editor/Inspector, a project-level automation API, build triggering, agent-facing tooling (MCP/API), and hands-on corroboration of agent-driven workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can drive the editor and project programmatically — create scenes and nodes, edit properties, trigger builds — through a documented scriptable interface

citations.quote: Provides a complete scene graph with lights, cameras, materials, meshes, sprites, layers, animations, audio clips, GUI elements, and actions
Meshes & Geometry: Primitive shapes, CSG operations, mesh manipulation
